breakdown.description: The prompt makes the torsional shear vanish at the outer surface, even though the torsional shear stress is also maximal there for a solid circular shaft.
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated that the torsional shear stress vanishes at the outer surface. The generated specification correctly includes the torsional shear stress τxy (from torsion) in the plane stress state for part (c), matching the ground truth. There is no mention of the shear stress vanishing; instead, it is properly included as a non-zero component in the stress transformation calculations.
